name: @profullstack/wx93-mcp

tools.name: shorten_url
tools.description: Shorten a URL with wx93.me and return the short link. Works without an account (free links open through a short ad page for people; bots and previews get the direct redirect). Signed-in Pro and Automation links redirect directly and can have aliases.

url.description: The long http(s) URL to shorten.

alias.description: Custom short code (Pro and up), 3-64 of A-Z a-z 0-9 - _.

domain.description: Which host the short link uses: wx93.me (default), 9xq.me, or a verified custom domain of yours (Automation). Codes resolve on both wx93.me and 9xq.me.

tools.name: bulk_shorten
tools.description: Shorten up to 1,000 URLs in one call (Automation plan). Returns one result per input, in order.

url.description: The long http(s) URL to shorten.

alias.description: Custom short code (Pro and up), 3-64 of A-Z a-z 0-9 - _.

domain.description: Which host the short link uses: wx93.me (default), 9xq.me, or a verified custom domain of yours (Automation). Codes resolve on both wx93.me and 9xq.me.

tools.name: list_links
tools.description: The account's short links, newest first, with click counts.

q.description: Filter by URL, code or title.

ref.description: The link id, its code, or the whole short URL.

tools.name: link_stats
tools.description: Clicks for one of your links: totals (people, QR scans, unique visitors, bots), and on Pro+ daily counts, referrers, countries, cities, devices, OS, browsers, a weekday-by-hour heatmap, week over week and the latest visits.

ref.description: The link id, its code, or the whole short URL.

tz.description: IANA time zone for the heatmap, e.g. America/New_York. Default UTC.

source.description: Only QR scans, or only plain clicks.

tools.name: update_link
tools.description: Change where one of your links goes, its title, expiry or redirect type.

ref.description: The link id, its code, or the whole short URL.

tools.name: delete_link
tools.description: Delete one of your links. It stops resolving at once.

ref.description: The link id, its code, or the whole short URL.

tools.name: expand_link
tools.description: Where a wx93.me short link goes, without following it.

tools.name: create_qr_code
tools.description: Save a styled QR code to the account and return it with a PNG preview. Dynamic types (url, vcard, event, links) encode a wx93 short link: scans are counted and the content can change after printing (vcard, event and links get a hosted page). Static types (text, wifi, email, phone, sms, whatsapp, geo, crypto) carry their content directly. Data keys per type: url {url}; vcard {first, last?, org?, title?, phone?, email?, url?, address?, note?}; event {title, start, end?, tz?, location?, description?, url?}; links {title, description?, links: "Label | https://… per line"}; text {text}; wifi {ssid, password?, encryption? WPA|WEP|nopass, hidden?}; email {to, subject?, body?}; phone {number}; sms {number, message?}; whatsapp {number, message?}; geo {lat, lng, label?}; crypto {coin, address, amount?, label?}.

style.description: How the code looks. Colours are hex. Too little contrast between fg and bg is refused.

eye.description: Colour of the three corner eyes; defaults to fg.

ecc.description: Error correction. A logo forces H.

domain.description: Dynamic codes: wx93.me (default), 9xq.me, or a verified custom domain.

alias.description: Dynamic codes, Pro and up: a custom short code.

tools.name: list_qr_codes
tools.description: The account's saved QR codes, newest first, with what each encodes and its scan count.

tools.name: get_qr_code
tools.description: One saved QR code, with the image as PNG and links to SVG and print-ready PDF.

id.description: The QR code id (a UUID from create_qr_code or list_qr_codes).

tools.name: update_qr_code
tools.description: Change a saved code's name, content (merged into its data) or style. A dynamic code keeps working after printing; a static one changes its picture.

id.description: The QR code id (a UUID from create_qr_code or list_qr_codes).

style.description: How the code looks. Colours are hex. Too little contrast between fg and bg is refused.

eye.description: Colour of the three corner eyes; defaults to fg.

ecc.description: Error correction. A logo forces H.

tools.name: delete_qr_code
tools.description: Delete a saved QR code (and, for a dynamic one, its short link).

id.description: The QR code id (a UUID from create_qr_code or list_qr_codes).

tools.name: qr_code_stats
tools.description: Scans of a dynamic QR code: people, unique visitors, bots; on Pro+ daily series, countries, cities, devices, OS, browsers, a weekday-by-hour heatmap, week over week, the last hour and the latest scans.

id.description: The QR code id (a UUID from create_qr_code or list_qr_codes).

tz.description: IANA time zone for the heatmap.

tools.name: whoami
tools.description: The signed-in account, its plan and this month's usage.

instructions: Shorten URLs with shorten_url (or bulk_shorten). Make styled, trackable QR codes with create_qr_code and read their scans with qr_code_stats. Without credentials links are free and open through a short ad page for people; set WX93_API_KEY or run `wx93 login` for Pro/Automation links, stats and aliases.
